semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides essential IP services that support semiconductor firms in protecting and managing their intellectual property.
summary: Khurana & Khurana (K&K) is a leading IP and Commercial Law firm in India, specializing in intellectual property services crucial for the semiconductor industry. They offer comprehensive IP procurement, management, and patent drafting services, helping semiconductor companies protect their intellectual assets and navigate IP law complexities.

regional_presence.India: Headquartered in India, K&K supports over 3000 corporates with IP services, including those in the semiconductor industry.
